ApoioImigrante.title: Welcome to Portugal
ApoioImigrante.subtitle: We know starting in a new country can be complex. We gathered here the essential steps for your digital and legal integration.
ApoioImigrante.nifDesc: The Tax Identification Number is essential to work, rent a house or open a bank account.
nifSteps: Find a fiscal representative (if outside the EU)
Schedule at Finanças or go to a branch
Bring passport and proof of address
ApoioImigrante.nissDesc: Required for contributions and access to the health system and social support.
ApoioImigrante.cplpDesc: Simplified process for citizens of the Community of Portuguese Language Countries.
ApoioImigrante.bankDesc: How to open a basic account to receive salary and pay bills.
ApoioImigrante.findServicesDesc: Discover where the nearest AIMA agencies, Citizen Shops, Health Centers, Finanças and Parish Councils are located relative to you.
